GDMS.Title: Google Drive Media
GDMS.RefreshHint: Scan the Google Drive folder again

Upload.Title: Upload to Google Drive
Upload.Author: Author
Upload.PackHint: The upload contains a scene JSON: all files go into one Maps/<author>/<folder>, and JSON references are updated to the new names.
Upload.SortHint: Maps go to Maps/<author>/<map name>, tokens to Tokens/<author>, music to Music/<author>, and so on.
Upload.ToFolder: Auto-sorting is off: files go into {folder}.
Upload.Convert: Convert png/jpg → webp and mp3/wav/flac → ogg

GDMS.UploadHint: Upload files into the selected Drive folder (you can also drop files on this window)
GDMS.EmptyIndex: No index yet. Set the API key in the module settings and click “Refresh index”.
GDMS.HasPack: A scene pack (walls, lights, sounds) sits next to this map
GDMS.Cached: Already copied to the Foundry server

Action.Tile: Place as a tile at screen centre (or drag onto the canvas)
Action.Scene: Create a scene with this map
Action.ImportPack: Import the scene with walls, lights and sounds
Action.Sound: Place an ambient sound at screen centre (or drag onto the canvas)

Notify.MissingMedia: {count} files were not found. See the console (F12).
Notify.ConversionFailed: {count} files could not be converted and were uploaded as they are. See the console (F12).

Errors.NoClientId: No OAuth Client ID in the module settings.
Errors.SignInRequired: Sign in with Google to upload (button in the search window).
Errors.NoCredentials: Set a Google API key in the module settings or sign in with Google.
Errors.NoFolder: No Google Drive folder in the module settings.
Errors.BadJson: The file is not valid JSON.
Errors.NotAScene: No scene data found in the file.
Errors.CannotPlace: This file type cannot be placed on the canvas.

Import.Title: Import scene
Import.Name: Name
Import.ConvertLevels: Convert Levels-module floors into V14 levels
Import.LevelHint: This scene was made in V14 with several levels. V13 has no levels, so each level becomes its own scene.

Convert.Title: Convert to V14 levels
Convert.NeedV14: Level conversion needs Foundry V14. In V13, upload the scene to Drive and import it in V14.
Convert.Found: Levels-module floors found. These levels will be created:
Convert.NotFound: No Levels-module data found. One level will be set up:
Convert.Duplicate: Work on a copy (keep the original)
Convert.Promote: Use the full-size floor tile as the level background
Convert.Surfaces: Create floor surfaces for upper floors (with Levels holes)
Convert.StairsOption: Turn Levels stairs and elevators into Change Level regions
Convert.Visibility: Upper floors can see the floors below
Convert.Done: “{name}”: {levels} levels, {tagged} placeables tagged, {stairs} stairs, {surfaces} surfaces, {promoted} backgrounds, {holes} holes

rootFolder.Name: Google Drive folder
rootFolder.Hint: Folder link or ID. For API-key browsing the folder must be shared with anyone who has the link.

apiKey.Name: Google API key
apiKey.Hint: A Google Cloud key with the Google Drive API enabled. Needed to browse and download.

oauthClientId.Name: OAuth Client ID
oauthClientId.Hint: Only needed to upload files and scenes. Type “Web application”; add your Foundry address to Authorized JavaScript origins.

storageSource.Name: Foundry storage
storageSource.Hint: Where files downloaded from Drive are saved.

cacheFolder.Name: Cache folder
cacheFolder.Hint: Folder in Foundry storage that Drive files are copied into.

soundRadius.Name: Sound radius
soundRadius.Hint: Ambient sound radius (scene units) when dropping audio.

playersCanBrowse.Name: Players can browse
playersCanBrowse.Hint: Show the search window to players (placing still needs the matching permissions).

autoSort.Name: Auto-sort on Drive
autoSort.Hint: Put uploads into Maps/<author>/<map>, Tokens, Tiles, Music, Ambience, SFX.

convertImages.Name: Convert images to WebP
convertImages.Hint: png, jpg, bmp, tiff become webp when uploaded to Drive.

convertAudio.Name: Convert audio to OGG
convertAudio.Hint: mp3, wav, flac, m4a become ogg (Opus) when uploaded to Drive.

webpQuality.Name: WebP quality
webpQuality.Hint: 85 looks like the original at 3–10× smaller than png.

convertOnImport.Name: Convert when copying into Foundry
convertOnImport.Hint: Save png/mp3 files already on Drive to the Foundry server as webp/ogg.

GDMS.TransferHint: Copy the scenes of a map module, or of this world, to Drive
GDMS.ConvertDriveHint: Convert png/jpg and mp3 in the selected Drive folder to webp and ogg

Export.Title: Upload scene to Google Drive
Export.Hint: The scene and all its files go into Maps/<author>/<folder>. The background is named after the folder, so the map shows a scene-pack badge.

ConvertDrive.Title: Convert files on Drive
ConvertDrive.Nothing: Nothing to convert in this folder.
ConvertDrive.Body: {count} files to convert in {folder}. .webp and .ogg versions will be created next to them.
ConvertDrive.Trash: Move the originals to the Google Drive trash (recoverable for 30 days)
ConvertDrive.Hint: Scene packs keep working: on import map.png is found as map.webp.

Transfer.Title: Transfer maps to Google Drive
Transfer.Intro: Pick an installed, enabled map module (or this world). Each scene is uploaded as a scene pack into Maps/<author>/<scene> with walls, lights, sounds and all files.
Transfer.Loose: Also copy the module's loose files (maps, tokens, music without scenes)
Transfer.Choose: {count} scenes. Author on Drive: {author}. Tick the ones to transfer:
